verdict.rationale: Kino AI is a cloud-backed video editing product, so choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question to ask of it. No evidence in the pack documents any region or residency selection. Mentions of local scrubbing and clips streaming from Kino describe playback and sync, not a user choice of where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
